maddeler.e:
اذلعببت (form IVq)
# اِذْلَعْبَبْتُ (iḏlaʕbabtu) /ið.laʕ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# اِذْلَعْبَبْتَ (iḏlaʕbabta) /ið.laʕ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
# اِذْلَعْبَبْتِ (iḏlaʕbabti) /ið.laʕ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِذْلَعَبَّ (iḏlaʕabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
